replacements.La paradoja resuelta: bienestar e ingres: The paradox resolved: well-being and income do not relate as simply as once thought
replacements.Kahneman y Killingsworth llegaron a conc: Kahneman and Killingsworth reached opposing conclusions for years. In 2023 they published an adversarial collaboration designed to reconcile them. Both were right, but for different people.
replacements.El bienestar subjetivo no sigue al ingre: Subjective well-being does not track income in the same way everywhere. These World Happiness Report 2024 data illustrate the tension.
replacements.Lidera el ranking por séptimo año consec: It leads the ranking for the seventh consecutive year. The difference from countries with similar income is not explained by income alone: institutional trust, social-support networks and perceived freedom to make life decisions explain it.
replacements.Renta materialmente inferior a Finlandia: Material income is substantially lower than Finland's, but the well-being gap (1.2 points) is not proportional to the income gap. Non-economic variables explain most of the difference.
replacements.Renta muy superior a Finlandia y bienest: Income is far higher than Finland's while well-being is lower. High national income does not guarantee high well-being when distribution is very unequal and job security and access to services vary.
replacements.La paradoja de Easterlin (1974) document: The Easterlin paradox (1974) first documented this pattern: within a country, higher income correlates with greater well-being. But across countries and over time, GDP growth does not produce the same increase in subjective well-being once a basic threshold has been crossed.
replacements.Para las personas que ya reportan bajo b: For people who already report low well-being, income stops improving daily emotional state above about $75,000 per year
replacements.Curva de bienestar hedónico vs ingreso p: Hedonic well-being versus income curve for the unhappy 20%
replacements.Aproximadamente el 20% de las personas q: Approximately the 20% of people who already report low well-being in their daily emotional state
replacements.Para este grupo, el ingreso adicional po: For this group, additional income above the threshold produces no appreciable improvement in hedonic well-being (absence of distress, immediate pleasure)
replacements.Hipótesis: cuando el malestar tiene raíc: Hypothesis: when distress has non-material roots (mental health, relationships, chronic conditions), additional income does not resolve them
replacements.Para la mayoría de las personas, el bien: For most people, well-being measured in real time continues to rise with income without an apparent ceiling. There is no plateau.
replacements.Curva de bienestar vs ingreso para la ma: Well-being versus income curve for the satisfied majority
replacements.Killingsworth midió bienestar en tiempo: Killingsworth measured well-being in real time with the Track Your Happiness app: questions at random moments during the day, not retrospective evaluations
replacements.Para la mayoría de las personas (el ~80%: For most people (the ~80% who do not report chronically low well-being), well-being continues to rise with income even above $75,000
replacements.La metodología importa: la evaluación en: Methodology matters: real-time evaluation captures hedonic states different from the retrospective life-satisfaction evaluation used by Kahneman
replacements.Colaboración adversarial 2023 — Kahneman: 2023 adversarial collaboration — Kahneman + Killingsworth + Barbara Mellers
replacements.Diseñada explícitamente para reconciliar: Explicitly designed to reconcile two contradictory findings. Result: both were correct for different subpopulations.
replacements.Resolución: dos curvas de bienestar vs i: Resolution: two well-being versus income curves for different subpopulations
replacements.Para el 20% de las personas con bienesta: For the 20% of people with chronically low well-being, income above about $75,000 produces no additional improvement in daily emotional state. The plateau exists for this group.
replacements.Para la mayoría satisfecha, el bienestar: For the satisfied majority, real-time well-being continues to rise with income without an apparent ceiling. The plateau does not apply to them.
replacements.Si la IA concentra las ganancias en quie: If AI concentrates gains among people who already have an advantage in income and well-being, the impact on the majority's subjective well-being can be neutral or negative even if aggregate GDP improves.
